_meta.purpose: Affiliate program registry for printlog3d.com. Same shape as the other portfolio sites.
_meta.format_note: Each program: { brand, base_url, tracking_param, tracking_value, status, network, commission, cookie, notes }. status = pending | queued_signup | enrolled | declined.
_meta.activation: Nothing on this site renders an Amazon link while status is 'pending'. Set status to 'enrolled' and put the real tracking ID in tracking_value, and GearAdvice starts rendering tagged, tracked links on every material page. That is the only change required.

amazon.notes: printlog3d.com has NO Amazon Associates tracking ID. Every other monetised property in the portfolio has its own (homesteadgr-20, digpicframe-20, bpmonitorlab-20 and so on) and a site must never borrow another site's tag. Suggested ID following the existing convention: printlog3d-20. Until it exists, isEnrolled('amazon') returns false and GearAdvice renders specification guidance with no outbound link, which is deliberate: the previous library template shipped 1,000 pages of untagged amazon.com/s?k= search links that earned nothing, alongside a printed claim that the site participates in the Associates program. Both are removed.
